7611: Cortech Endurance All Plastic ADA Wall Mount Desk
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-7611-endurance-ada-compliant-floor-mounted-desk
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/endurance-wall-mount-ada-desk/
Spec sheets: 7611, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance All Plastic ADA Wall Mount Desk – 7611
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Floor Mounted Desk ADA‑Compliant - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 76111
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded ADA-Compliant Desk That Bolts to the Wall and Floor
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 7611 Endurance ADA All Plastic Floor Mount Desk
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance All Plastic ADA Wall Mount Desk gives people who use wheelchairs a fixed, accessible desk in cells, patient rooms, and other secure settings. It meets all ADA requirements, with knee and toe space and clear floor space for a front approach.
The desk is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It bolts to the wall and floor through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
ADA Compliance: Meets all ADA requirements, with knee and toe space and clear floor space for a front approach
Dimensions: 38”W×22”D×31”H
Weight: 34 lbs
Mounting: Bolts to the wall and floor through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
7611 – All Plastic: 38”W×22”D×31”H, 34 lbs
Installation and Options
Mounting: Bolt to the wall and floor through concealed pilot holes; Cortech instructions show eight wall and two floor 3/8”-16×2½” tamper-proof security Torx anchor bolts
[H2] Applications
The All Plastic ADA Desk suits accessible rooms where a desk must stay fixed in place and leave clear space for a wheelchair.
Typical applications include:
Accessible cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Accessible patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and other rooms that need an ADA-compliant desk
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (58 characters): Cortech Endurance All Plastic ADA Desk - 7611 at Anchortex
Meta description (149 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance All Plastic ADA Desk. A one-piece molded ADA-compliant desk that bolts to the wall and floor, for cells and patient rooms.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: your current H1 says "Floor Mounted Desk" and "Model 76111" (a typo for 7611). Cortech calls it the Endurance Wall Mount ADA Desk (all plastic), and it bolts to both the wall and the floor, so I used "All Plastic ADA Wall Mount Desk." Is that okay?
Mounting: your current page says "Bolts to the floor (hardware not included)." The Cortech spec sheet says it bolts to the wall and floor, so I used that.
Weight: your variant is set to 40 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 34 lbs, so I used 34 lbs.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Product images: the page has one image (Midnight Blue). Would you like me to look for more Cortech photos?
